title: Interactive Memory Learning for Long-Term Conversations
abstract: arXiv:2609.17088v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advancements in large language models have significantly enhanced the capabilities of agents in modeling long-term conversations. Despite these successes, existing approaches typically adopt a static heuristic paradigm, where information is passively archived without adaptive memory valuation. Consequently, these methods fail to self-evolve or align their memory management with evolving user needs. To address this, we propose ICML (InteraCtive Memory Learning), a multi-agent framework that transforms the memory mechanism from a passive archive into a learnable, interactive memory policy. Specifically, we first employ a session synthesis pipeline to generate expert data, facilitating rapid test-time adaptation in unseen scenarios. Building on this, ICML utilizes an online reinforcement learning mechanism where a Planner agent selectively encodes high-value information and a Trigger agent dynamically retrieves it to optimize respons

translated_title: 面向长期对话的交互式记忆学习
translated_abstract: 大语言模型的最新进展显著增强了智能体在建模长期对话方面的能力。尽管取得了这些成功，现有方法通常采用静态启发式范式，即信息被被动地存档，而缺乏自适应的记忆价值评估。因此，这些方法无法自我演化，也无法使记忆管理与不断变化的用户需求保持一致。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了ICML（交互式记忆学习），这是一个多智能体框架，它将记忆机制从被动存档转变为可学习、可交互的记忆策略。具体而言，我们首先采用会话合成流水线生成专家数据，以便在未见过的场景中实现快速的测试时适应。在此基础上，ICML利用在线强化学习机制，其中规划器智能体有选择地编码高价值信息，触发器智能体动态地检索这些信息以优化响应。
tldr: 该论文提出ICML多智能体框架，通过在线强化学习将长期对话中的记忆机制从被动存档转变为可学习的交互式记忆策略，使记忆管理能够自我演化并动态适应用户需求变化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ICML, a multi-agent framework that transforms memory mechanisms in long-term conversations from passive archiving into a learnable, interactive memory policy via online reinforcement learning, enabling memory management to self-evolve and dynamically adapt to evolving user needs.
